_note: Every number here is a business assumption YOU must defend in REPORT.md. Edit, then rerun `uv run python main.py train` (or just restart the app: it recomputes live). Unit of decision: one drone photo of one insulator string.
_positive_why: Positive = the photo shows a damaged insulator. That is the case where a crew must go out.
_base_rate_why: PLACEHOLDER. Share of insulator strings on a real line that are actually damaged. The test split is mostly faulty photos, nothing like a real line; the cost maths reweights to this number.
_cost_fn_why: PLACEHOLDER. Missed fault: the insulator stays until the next inspection cycle. Expected cost = P(flashover/outage before then) x (unplanned outage + emergency repair + penalties/wildfire risk).
_cost_fp_why: PLACEHOLDER. False dispatch: crew + truck/climbing team sent to a tower for nothing (half a day of a 2-3 person crew).
_cost_tp_why: Correct dispatch still pays the crew trip; the avoided loss is captured by NOT paying cost_fn. (The insulator part is paid either way, so it is left out.)
_cases_per_day_why: PLACEHOLDER. Insulator photos one drone team captures per day of inspection.
_review_seconds_why: PLACEHOLDER. An engineer zooms into one flagged photo and decides.
_reviewers_why: Engineers you can actually assign to photo review; the chosen review band is constrained to fit this.
